description: This file defines classes and structures for implementing task strands with various locking and prioritization policies, including single and multiple priority levels, for task execution management in a concurrent environment.

classes.name: priority_strand_queue
classes.description: Manages multiple priority queues with a consumer interface for task retrieval.

classes.name: strand_queue
classes.description: Manages a single queue with non-blocking behavior and retry logic.

classes.name: basic_strand_lock
classes.description: Implements a lock-like mechanism to ensure sequential task processing in a strand.

classes.name: force_dispatch_strand_lock
classes.description: Extends basic_strand_lock with forced dispatching based on task priority and internal locking.

classes.name: task_strand_impl
classes.description: Template class implementing the core logic of a task strand with locking policy and queue management.

classes.name: task_strand
classes.description: Implements a task strand with optional prioritization and batching, dispatching tasks to an executor.

classes.name: priority_task_strand_executor
classes.description: Executor that dispatches tasks with a specific priority to a strand supporting multiple priorities.

classes.name: priority_task_strand
classes.description: Implements a task strand supporting multiple priority levels, dispatching tasks accordingly.

methods.name: on_new_task
methods.description: Called when a new task is enqueued; updates internal task count and determines if strand is acquired.

methods.name: get_queue_size
methods.description: Returns the current number of pending tasks in the strand.

methods.name: on_task_completion
methods.description: Updates task count after tasks are completed and attempts to unlock the strand if zero tasks remain.

methods.name: handle_enqueued_task
methods.description: Determines if the strand should dispatch a task to run enqueued tasks.

methods.name: run_enqueued_tasks
methods.description: Runs all enqueued tasks in the strand, handling batching and re-queuing if necessary.

methods.name: dispatch_value_dequeue_task
methods.description: Dispatches a batch task to dequeue and run tasks from the queue.

methods.name: handle_failed_task_dispatch
methods.description: Handles failure to dispatch tasks by discarding remaining queued tasks.

methods.name: execute
methods.description: Enqueues a task and attempts to handle its execution within the strand.

methods.name: defer
methods.description: Enqueues a task with the same behavior as execute, but intended for deferred execution.

methods.name: get_executors
methods.description: Returns a span of executors for different priority levels supported by the strand.
